missing_information_behavior: If any required context is unknown, do not issue a positive recommendation; request clarification or professional review.
safety_exclusions: Do not infer deficiency from food frequency alone; do not recommend preformed retinol without life-stage and total-intake checks.
professional_escalation_conditions: Pregnancy, liver disease, malabsorption, retinoid medicines, night blindness or suspected deficiency.
population_and_context: Users with low intake of vitamin A-rich foods; assess dietary pattern and form-specific sources.
dose_constraints: No dose from this rule; separate preformed retinol from provitamin A carotenoids and assess total intake.
certainty_and_limitations: NIH ODS Vitamin A fact sheet; food intake estimates and form-specific conversion require careful interpretation. This rule remains draft; source passage extraction, critical appraisal, certainty assessment and professional approval are required before activation.
